changes.before: Repeat only while a condition holds
changes.after: A while loop repeats only while its condition is true.

before: A loop repeats instructions. while (condition) tests its condition before every repetition, including the first. If the condition is already false, its body runs zero times.
The statements between the loop braces form its body. Here turns = turns - 1; calculates one less than the current value and assigns that result back to turns.
The output happens before the subtraction in this example. After the body finishes, execution returns to the condition rather than immediately continuing below the loop.
A loop needs a way to stop. Here turns decreases until turns > 0 becomes false. Removing that update would keep repeating for a positive starting value.
after: A loop repeats instructions. while checks its condition before each repeat, including the first. If the first check is false, the loop does not run its body at all.
The body is the code inside the braces. turns = turns - 1 subtracts one from the current value and stores the result back in turns.
In this example, WriteLine shows the value before it is reduced. After the body finishes, the program goes back to check the condition.
Here, turns gets smaller until turns > 0 is false. Without the subtraction, a positive starting value would keep this loop repeating. A loop needs a way to stop.

after: Check the condition before entering the loop.

before.question: If turns starts at 0 instead of 3, what does this while-loop program display?
choices: 0, then Done, because a loop always runs once.
Only Done; the body is skipped when its first condition is false.
Nothing; false conditions stop the whole program.
before.explanation: while tests before entering. Zero is not greater than zero, so the loop body is skipped and the next output statement still runs.

after.question: If turns starts at 0, what does this program print?
choices: 0, then Done, because every loop runs once.
Only Done, because the first condition is false.
Nothing, because a false condition stops the whole program.
after.explanation: The loop body is skipped. The statement after the loop still prints Done.
